notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.notes:
Hi all!!

this saturday I was a the MIGF ( Montrel Independent Game Festival ) and it was so much fun! A lot of people showed up, I had a stand to let people try out the game and they jsut loved it! Some people actually voted Ant Queen as their favorite!!!

So thank you again for the great support. All of this is possible thanks to all the players that keep helping me to fix and upgrade the game.

About this patch 3.3

Story Mode :
 - The Queen should stop moving in randomize destinations
 - Level 1 - The collider that makes the game succesfull was too small. It will   detect more easily when the queen reaches the hole.
 - Level 2 - The Path finding was too precise and some ants where getting stuck in the inside colony. Should not happen anymore
 - Level 19 - The Ui Icon to get outside the  red ant colony were acting weird... replaced them with what the should be.

Unlimited / Sandbox:
 - Queen starts with 100Hp in easy, 80 in Medium,50 in hard
 - Easy mode is easier. Red ants spawning rate is slower and they do less damage
 
Thanks again and let me know i f you see something

Next patch
- fix the achivement system fixed
- Unlimited NPC spawn rate nerf

notes.title: Patch 2.7 - Green Ants galore
notes.notes:
Hi community and players,

We are continuing our frequent updates and giving a player a wish : a more costly but yet more powerful ant type - the green ants !

Also, we did crushed some bugs, as appropriate for ants masterz, and made minor adjustments to both the story mode and the sandbox :
- blue, red and yellow ants are 25% more expensive
- green ants are an additional 25% compared to other ants
- we added a UI cue for ants' costs
- the new patrol system is now also available in story mode
- workers use less CPU and memory while doing the same job (good efficient workers is what a Queen likes !)
- achievements have been added for the green ants
- music has been added for the sandbox mode

TODO : 
- add survival mode to the sandbox (with scoring)
- balance green ants compared to the rest

REQUEST TO PLAYERS : a player has noticed a crash at the end of level 15 in story mode that would be due to garbage collection (GC error message) :
- we would appreciate any player encountering it sending a PM or a comment here 
- any player that would feel like testing it, we would love to get feedback if it happens to you

We hope you continue enjoy the game, do not hesitate to post comment and suggestions as usual !

notes.title: Patch 2.6
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

SandBox:
 - In this patch, we added the option for the players to set patrol points rather than having the ants patrol between the nest and foraging zones. 
 - the player can click on a new UI flag button and after click on the ground to set an orange flag. Soldiers and Super Soldiers will patrol between does points and the colony.
 - Flags cannot be set on water, rocks or on the players nest.
 - the player can delete all patrol flags with a UI button.
 - When red ants go inside the colony, the player's ants that are insided the colony will rush to defend from the intruders. The queen will be the last one to die.
- If the player has no more nursers, the first nursers can become mature on it's own.
- There is always atleast one RedAnt Nurser.
- Red ants that are in their colony, are harder to kill and do more damage
- Made a mix of the songs to not have the same song on loop

StoryMode
 - fixed level 10 victory condition. Sorry...

This Working on
 - Adding a 5th type of ant, the green ants. These ants will be more expansive and overall better than other ants.
 - Add a box for the mini-map
 - Add a second Red Ant Colony in the Hard Sandbox mode
 - Add a survival mode in the sandbox
 - Add achivements for the sandbox

Thank you again for all of your input
inVantage

notes.title: SandBox Update 4.2
notes.notes:
Alot of features have been added in this version

- Corrected the minimap size
- Added the option to delete units
- Added the option to make the game run X2 speed or Normal Speed
- Added A UI button to change the location of your chambers - Cost of 5 Food
- Added the option to build Egg, Larva and Cocoon chambers.
- Each chamber cost the player Food, 15-25-35
- Added a laying chamber, this is needed in the situation where all chambers are full and the player want to drop an egg to be able to use the nurser for an other reason
- Chambers can be saved/loaded
- The player can now have one egg, larva or coocon per chamber
- The egg, larva and coocon have a timer to grow, depending on what ant the development time is different
- corrected the Red Ants spawning time and HP and Damage
- Small Beetles are easier to kill
-Optimazed the scripts
-Nursers take less CPU
-Rendere has been Optimize


To Do
-Try the Story Mode to see if things didn't get messy
-Work on the Main Menu page, add ants walking in the colony
-Mix the songs to not have the same song on loop
-see if we can put the back the undeground mites NPCs
-Check if the queen loses health too fast when the colony is big.
-Check Performance limit

Thank you and have fun!
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: SandBox Update 3
notes.notes:
The progress continues!

- Fixed the spawning of the Red Ant colony ants
- Added a Mini-Map to the Game (can be toggled ON/OFF with the Letter "m")
- To set a dirt to green, you need to press the KeyBoard Letter "d" and click with the Mouse.
- If you Deactivate the Digging Icon, all green dirts capsules become Brown again.
- Nurser don't go outside anymore, unless you are on the War mode.
- Ants type colour difference is more drastic.
- Spawning NPC are now all 3 types of spiders, all 3 types of caterpillars and the beetle.
- NPCs now always drop food.
-Some NPCs are bigger and leave bigger food spots;
-Food inside the colony is savec
- If you Save your game, the digging paths you created are also saved
- optimized a lot many settgins of the game

To Do
- try out if the Red Ant Ai is not too easy now
- get some video of gameplay from you guys
- Add an achivment for when you killed all 3 red ant queens.
- Merge the song of the game to not ahve the same song on loop.

If you have any comments pleaze feel free to let us know here

Thank you
Invantage

notes.title: Sandbox update 2
notes.notes:
Sandbox beta is going well!!
We are adding achievement in the game with steam works and theses will work for the sandbox and the story mode.

We are starting with 20 achievements such as:
 -5 caterpillars killed - Gummy
 -5 Beetles killed - Carapace breaker 
 -1000HP queen - Queen-B
 -Etc..

We are done with having the queen change colour depending on what kind of ants is the most commun in your colony

Digging system is being optimized. Gameplay would slow down when some paths would become unreachable 

We fixed the story mode bug. The ants can go back inside the colony while in story mode in the beta version.

We added UI text that flashes when your ants are under attack or when your queen is low on health.

Things to do,
 Work on making ants difference more drastic depending on what colour of ants you have.

This update will be added this week 

Thank you all
